warnings.t: Management / m1: RAID-6 4+2 (FTT=2) (auto) needs 6 hosts and the cluster has 6, so with a host in maintenance or failed, vSAN can't rebuild to full protection. Add a host for that.
WLD-DENSE / d1: set to 3 hosts but needs 17 (CPU).
WLD-DENSE / d1: RAID-6 4+2 (FTT=2) (auto) needs 6 hosts and the cluster has 3, so with a host in maintenance or failed, vSAN can't rebuild to full protection. Add a host for that.
WLD-DENSE / d1: 1,333 VMs per host, above the 500 per host vSAN ESA supports. Add hosts.
WLD-DENSE / n1: needs 366 hosts, above its max of 96. Move workloads placed here to Auto or another cluster, or raise the max.
Instance i1: 41 workload domains; a VCF instance supports up to 40.
WLD-BIG: 2,560 hosts is above the 2,500 hosts one vCenter supports. Split it into more workload domains.
WLD-SML: 120 hosts and 0 VMs is beyond a small vCenter (100 hosts / 1,000 VMs). Pick a larger vCenter.
WLD-DENSE: 369 hosts and 7,000 VMs is beyond a medium vCenter (400 hosts / 4,000 VMs). Pick a larger vCenter.
